pages.text: Synthesis returns all verified earned points from both parents: invested levels plus unused points. It does not add their final attributes, equipment effects, or ancient passives. The result begins with zero invested levels and the entire balance unused.

Example: 21 invested + 4 unused from the ordinary miner, plus 16 invested + 2 unused from the ancient miner, becomes 43 unused points. The next growth cost counts all 43 inherited points. Training limits remain unchanged; excess points remain unused without being discarded.

Formal ancient restoration training counts when its growth record is verifiable. Parents with Creative-edited base stats cannot be used. Older companions are accepted only when their invested and unused totals match their earned history. A rejected input remains intact; the station explains what needs attention.
